d.ko: Cartel Tycoon is a survival business sim inspired by the ‘80s and '90s narco trade. Expand and conquer, fight off rival thugs and evade the authorities. Earn people's loyalty and strive to overcome the doomed fate of a power-hungry drug lord.
d.en: Cartel Tycoon is a survival business sim inspired by the ‘80s and '90s narco trade. Expand and conquer, fight off rival thugs and evade the authorities. Earn people's loyalty and strive to overcome the doomed fate of a power-hungry drug lord.
d.zh: 《Cartel Tycoon》是一款生存商业模拟游戏，创作灵感来自80年代的毒品交易。不断扩张与征服，击退对手并躲避有关当局的关注。赢得人们的忠诚度并努力克服渴望权力毒枭的天注之命。
